description: This file defines the MessagingFragment class, an Android Fragment that manages UI components for messaging interactions, including buttons to send messages and a log display. It handles service connection to MessagingService via Messenger, updates UI based on service state, and manages message logging and preferences.

classes.name: MessagingFragment
classes.description: Main UI fragment for messaging, handling service binding, user interactions, and message logging.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes UI components, sets click listeners, and disables buttons initially.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks to send messages or clear logs.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Binds to MessagingService when fragment starts.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates log display and registers preference change listener.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Unbinds from MessagingService when fragment stops.

methods.name: sendMsg
methods.description: Creates and sends a message to the service with specified conversation parameters.

methods.name: setButtonsState
methods.description: Enables or disables message buttons based on service connection state.
